title: Is there an infinite strictly descending sequence of scl values in a free group?
body:
## The question

Is there a single explicit example of an infinite strictly decreasing sequence of
values of scl in a free group?

The question is not vacuous: scl is bounded below by 1/2 on the commutator subgroup
of a free group, so any such sequence converges, and its limit is an accumulation
point of the spectrum from above. Exhibiting one would therefore also exhibit an
accumulation point, and conversely an accumulation point approached from above
gives such a sequence.

What is wanted is an explicit family, not an existence argument.
